text:
hana: Quick follow-up from crit — main asks: make sampling unambiguous, improve p95 legibility, and consider a "confidence ribbon". 

jordan: For sampling copy: explicit is best. `Sampling: 0.2% (≈1 in 500)` — no one should guess percent vs fraction. 

lee: p95 overlay idea: dashed 2px stroke + 1px subtle glow when over warm buckets. keeps line visible without overpowering. 

sam: confidence ribbon sketch: faint band around p95 showing 10-90 spread, alpha 0.12. low visual weight but communicates variance. 

hana: mobile rule: hide overlay by default, show ribbon only on expanded view. desktop: overlay on by default (auto mode). 

jordan: scrubber hit target: increase invisible hit area to 28px, keep visual thumb 10px. keyboard focus should show tooltip with shortcuts. 

lee: presets naming test: Throughput / Balanced / Precision — PMs liked that framing. add brief microcopy for each in dropdown. 

sam: a11y: expose p50/p95+sample size as a single aria-live summary on range change to avoid verbosity. Also add aria-labels for preset chips. 

uxbot: Prototype: https://staging.redwood.dev/latency/2001234567 — includes ribbon, adaptive overlay, sampling copy. User-test booked Fri 14:00 (4 participants). 

hana: owners: jordan = copy + presets; lee = overlay + palette; sam = a11y + keyboard. Quick sync Thu 9am. thanks!
